title: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: In this task, you are to write an essay on the necessity of developing social skills for college students. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: In today's interconnected campus life, the necessity of developing social skills for college students can hardly be overstated. Far from being an optional extra, the ability to communicate and cooperate is indispensable to a student's growth. To begin with, strong social skills lie at the heart of academic success. Much college learning happens through group projects, seminars and lab work, where students who express ideas clearly and listen to others achieve far more than those who work in isolation. Moreover, these skills pave the way for future careers. Employers today value teamwork and communication as highly as professional knowledge, and graduates who can network and collaborate stand out in interviews. Equally important, good social skills help students build friendships, ease loneliness and adapt to campus life smoothly. Therefore, developing social skills is by no means a trivial matter but a genuine necessity for every college student. Universities and students alike should treat it as seriously as academic study, so that young people can thrive both on campus and beyond.
keyPoints: 背景加立场落地。本段落实了『背景一句引出立场』：先用 In today's interconnected campus life 一句背景铺垫，再用 can hardly be overstated 和 Far from being an optional extra... is indispensable 正面亮出立场，扣住 the necessity of developing social skills for college students， 一开篇就完成了『立场』这一功能。

衔接词串起三例。本段落实了『衔接词串三理由』：用 To begin with 引学业维度（group projects, seminars and lab work），Moreover 递进到就业维度（Employers today value teamwork），Equally important 收口个人维度（build friendships, ease loneliness），三条理由各带 校园实例，层层加码而非松散并列。
因果重申带倡议。本段落实了『因果词重申加倡议』：Therefore 把上文收成结论，by no means a trivial matter but a genuine necessity 重申必要性，末句 should treat it as seriously as academic study 补上倡议，逻辑闭环、有落点。
